verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa lābhino;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who get the essence of the meaning, the essence of the teaching, and the essence of freedom are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa na lābhino.
verses.english: while the sentient beings who don’t get the essence of the meaning, the essence of the teaching, and the essence of freedom are many.
So you should train like this:
‘We will get the essence of the meaning, the essence of the teaching, the essence of freedom.’
